falseSynonyms.zh: 年齡範圍不一定等於年齡限制 age range 可只是描述一群人的年齡分布，不一定具有規則或限制。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The class has an age range of 18 to 25, but that does not necessarily mean those are formal age limits.

falseSynonyms.zh: 年齡組別不等於限制 age group 是分類，例如 teenagers 或 18–24-year-olds；不是資格規則。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An age group describes people; an age restriction controls eligibility.

falseSynonyms.zh: 建議年齡不等於硬性限制 recommendation 可以只是建議，未必強制執行；limit/restriction 通常具規則性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A recommended age may guide users without legally preventing access.

falseSynonyms.zh: 年齡差不等於年齡界線 age difference 指兩人或兩組之間相差多少歲，不涉及資格限制。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An age difference compares ages; an age limit sets a boundary.

falseSynonyms.zh: 年齡結構不等於限制 age profile 描述某群體的年齡組成，常用於統計或人口分析。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A customer age profile is descriptive, not a restriction.

falseSynonyms.zh: 年齡類別不等於資格限制 category 只是分類；只有當分類同時決定能否參加時，才可能和 eligibility 有關。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An age category labels a group; an age limit controls who qualifies.
